description: This Java source file defines an Android Service called 'ServiceStartArguments' that demonstrates handling background tasks within an app, including notification management, thread handling, and start/stop lifecycle management. It also contains an inner activity class 'Controller' that provides UI controls to start the service with various parameters.

classes.name: ServiceStartArguments
classes.description: An Android Service that processes background commands, shows notifications, and manages a separate thread for task execution.

classes.name: ServiceStartArguments.Controller
classes.description: An inner Activity class providing UI controls to start the service with different parameters, simulating various operational scenarios.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up notification manager, creates a handler thread, and prepares message handling.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming start requests, enqueues message processing, and manages restart behavior based on intent extras.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up the service, stops the handler thread, cancels notifications, and shows a shutdown message.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as this is a started service, not a bound service.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Displays a notification indicating ongoing processing within the service.
